function.name: answer_question
function.description: This function transfers the chat interaction to a human agent when the automated system encounters a question that it cannot answer. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

statement.description: The question posed by the user that needs to be transferred to a human agent.

urgency.description: The level of urgency for the question to be answered.

language.description: The language in which the question is asked, using ISO 639-1 codes (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish).

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have enough information to provide an accurate estimate for your package’s arrival time. If you could share your order number or let me know where the shipment is currently located, I’ll do my best to look up the most recent tracking details for you.
message.reasoning: User wants to know the minimum package arrival time. We have no data about packages or shipping times. According to policy, we should not provide an estimate. We can ask clarifying questions. But the user specifically asks for the minimum package arrival time. We need to respond with a refusal because we don't have enough info. We can offer to help find more details. So we refuse and say we can't give an estimate.
